title: 全球 GDP 增速（示意）
note: 示意性年度近似值，用于展示长期趋势与波动幅度，非实时数据。2020 年深度下滑反映疫情冲击，2021 年为低基数反弹。具体数值请以 IMF 等官方发布为准。
noteEn: Illustrative annual approximations showing long-run trend and volatility, not real-time data. The 2020 slump reflects the pandemic and 2021 is a base-effect rebound. Consult official IMF releases for exact figures.

sources.label: IMF《世界经济展望》（近似整理）

title: 全球通胀率（示意）
note: 示意性年度近似值。2021–2023 年出现数十年未见的高位，主要来自供给冲击、需求结构变化与劳动力紧张，随后随政策收紧回落。
noteEn: Illustrative annual approximations. The 2021–2023 spike was the highest in decades, driven by supply shocks, demand shifts and tight labour markets, then eased as policy tightened.

sources.label: IMF《世界经济展望》通胀数据（近似整理）
sources.labelEn: IMF World Economic Outlook inflation data (approximated)

title: 发达经济体失业率（示意）
note: 示意性年度近似值。2020 年因统计口径差异（部分经济体将停薪留职计入就业）实际冲击可能被低估，解读时需注意口径。
noteEn: Illustrative annual approximations. In 2020 differing definitions — some economies counted furloughed workers as employed — may understate the real shock, so definitions matter.

sources.label: ILO / OECD 就业统计（近似整理）

title: 美国联邦基金利率（示意）
note: 示意性年度近似值（取年末区间上沿）。2020–2021 年接近零利率下限，2022–2023 年为四十年来最快加息周期。
noteEn: Illustrative annual approximations using the upper bound at year end. Rates sat at the zero lower bound in 2020–2021, followed by the fastest hiking cycle in forty years in 2022–2023.

sources.label: 美联储公开市场委员会利率决议（近似整理）

title: 美元兑人民币（示意）
note: 示意性年度近似值（年末中间价附近）。曲线上行表示美元升值、人民币相对贬值。汇率受利率差、贸易与资本流动共同影响，不由单一因素决定。
noteEn: Illustrative year-end approximations. A rising line means a stronger dollar and a relatively weaker renminbi. Rates reflect rate differentials, trade and capital flows together, not one factor alone.

sources.label: 中国外汇交易中心 / 公开汇率数据（近似整理）

title: 发达经济体政府债务占 GDP 比重（示意）
note: 示意性年度近似值。2020 年跳升来自疫情支出与产出下滑的「分母效应」，此后随通胀与名义增长部分回落，但绝对水平仍高于疫情前。
noteEn: Illustrative annual approximations. The 2020 jump came from pandemic spending plus a smaller denominator; inflation and nominal growth brought it down somewhat, yet levels remain above pre-pandemic.

sources.label: IMF 财政监测（近似整理）

title: 中国 GDP 增速（示意）
note: 示意性年度近似值，取自中国官方公布的 GDP 同比实际增速。2020 年受疫情冲击明显放缓，2021 年为低基数反弹，此后回归中高速区间。具体数值请以中国国家统计局发布为准。
noteEn: Illustrative annual approximations from China's officially published year-on-year real GDP growth. 2020 slowed sharply under the pandemic, 2021 rebounded on a low base, then growth returned to a mid-to-high range. Consult China's National Bureau of Statistics for exact figures.

sources.label: 中国国家统计局 GDP 数据（近似整理）
sources.labelEn: China's National Bureau of Statistics GDP data (approximated)

title: 全球极端贫困率（示意）
note: 示意曲线：世界银行口径下、日均生活费低于极端贫困线的全球人口占比，整体呈长期显著下降；2020 年前后因疫情短暂反弹，其后基本回到下行轨道。数值为量级近似，仅用于说明趋势，非逐年精算，具体请以世界银行公布为准。
noteEn: Stylised series: the share of the world's people living below the World Bank's extreme-poverty line, on a long decline; a brief pandemic-era uptick around 2020, then back on course. Values are order-of-magnitude approximations for trend, not exact—consult the World Bank for figures.

sources.label: 世界银行 Poverty and Shared Prosperity（近似整理）
sources.labelEn: World Bank, Poverty and Shared Prosperity (approximated)

title: 全球收入前 10% 所占份额（示意）
note: 示意曲线：国民总收入中，收入最高的前 10% 成年人所占份额。二十世纪上半叶高企，中期因战争、税负与普惠增长而回落，近数十年再度上行。取世界不平等数据库的量级近似，仅示意趋势，非精算。
noteEn: Stylised series: the share of national income taken by the richest tenth of adults. High in the early twentieth century, lower through the mid-century wars, taxes and broad growth, then rising again in recent decades. Values are order-of-magnitude approximations from the World Inequality Database, showing trend only.

sources.label: 世界不平等数据库（近似整理）

title: 全球老年抚养比（示意）
note: 示意曲线：65 岁及以上人口相对 15—64 岁劳动年龄人口之比，即每一百名劳动年龄人口需赡养多少长者。因生育率下降与寿命延长，全球数值长期上行，预测段持续抬升。取联合国《世界人口展望》的量级近似。
noteEn: Stylised series: people aged 65+ relative to those of 15–64 working age—elders supported per hundred working-age people. It rises over the long run as fertility falls and lives lengthen, with the projected segment continuing upward. Values approximate the UN World Population Prospects.

sources.label: 联合国《世界人口展望》（近似整理）

title: 全球城镇化率（示意）
note: 示意曲线：居住在城市地区的人口占全球总人口的比例，长期稳步上升，且新增城市人口主要来自亚洲与非洲。取联合国《世界城镇化展望》的量级近似，其中未来值为预测，仅示意趋势。
noteEn: Stylised series: the share of the world's population living in urban areas, rising steadily, with most new urban dwellers added in Asia and Africa. Values approximate the UN World Urbanization Prospects; forward points are projections, shown for trend.

sources.label: 联合国《世界城镇化展望》（近似整理）

title: 世界贸易额占 GDP（示意）
titleEn: World Trade as a Share of GDP (Illustrative)
note: 示意性年度近似值：货物与服务进出口合计占世界 GDP 的比重，展示全球化上行、2008 年回踩与近年的供应链重构，非实测统计。口径（货物或含服务、名义或实际）不同数值会有出入，请以 WTO 与世界银行发布为准。
noteEn: Illustrative annual approximations of goods plus services trade flows as a share of world GDP, showing the globalisation climb, the 2008 setback and recent supply-chain reconfiguration, not measured statistics. Figures move with the definition (goods versus goods-plus-services, nominal versus real), so consult WTO and World Bank releases.

sources.label: WTO / 世界银行（近似整理）

title: 全球研发支出占 GDP（示意）
titleEn: Global R&D Spending as a Share of GDP (Illustrative)
note: 示意性年度近似值：全球研发总支出相当于世界 GDP 的比重，近年主要由高收入经济体与中国的投入推升。各机构口径（企业出资与高校出资、购买力平价换算）不同，请以 UNESCO 科学报告为准。
noteEn: Illustrative annual approximations of total world R&D as a share of world GDP, lifted in recent years mainly by high-income economies and China. Shares differ across definitions (business versus higher-education funding, purchasing-power conversion), so consult UNESCO science reports.

title: 全球平均预期寿命（示意）
note: 示意性近似值：出生时平均预期寿命的长期上行与 2020 至 2021 年的疫情回撤；区域差异巨大，最高与最低地区可差约 20 岁。请以 WHO 全球健康观察数据为准。
noteEn: Illustrative approximations of average life expectancy at birth, its long climb and the 2020 to 2021 pandemic setback, with regional gaps that can span roughly two decades. Consult WHO Global Health Observatory data for exact figures.

sources.label: WHO 全球健康观察（近似整理）

title: 可再生能源占全球发电量（示意）
note: 示意性年度近似值：含水电在内的可再生能源占全球发电的比重，光伏与风电是近年增长的主引擎。各机构对「可再生」的界定（是否含水电、核电）不同，请以 IEA 与 Ember 发布为准。
noteEn: Illustrative annual approximations of renewables including hydropower as a share of world electricity generation, with solar and wind the recent growth engines. Shares move with what counts as renewable (hydro in, nuclear out), so consult IEA and Ember releases.
